five_channels.role: OH dephasing; off-diagonal damping2*gamma_dephasing under D[Z]

frame_hypothesis: LAB_PHASE_LOCKED_DRIVE: h_lab(t)=h0+OmegaR(exp(-i omega_d t)sigma_plus+exp(i omega_d t)sigma_minus); R=exp(i omega_d t Ntotal), rho_rot=R rho_lab R_dagger. This is extra named modeling inR57, not hidden reinterpretation of patent absolute frequencies.

findings.statement: Full64x64 finite GKLS and exp(tL) already exist. Collapse representation fixes five weighted system channels; implementation does not construct exterior bosonic fields, a joint system-bath unitary, measured output algebra or temporal wave packets.

R7 contains microwave-source B(rho)=-i[sigma_x,rho], count detector Cdet*n_o, Duhamel kernel and resolvent. This is causal linear response about assumed stationary rho_star, not a QRT formula for output-field correlations, not a bath dilation, and not a chosen temporal mode.

Under LAB_PHASE_LOCKED_DRIVE, R(t)=exp(i omega_d t N_total) changes absolute frequencies to detunings, while jump phases cancel in D[L]. R57 explicitly says the patent did not specify that frame. A detector or exterior LO must be transformed as well; phase cancellation of dissipators does not make the readout phase disappear.

Loss amplitude sqrt(kappa)a, homodyneLO, heterodyne/HBT and multiplicative G_OH are written. They do not by themselves specify b_out, bath input, shot-noise normalization, time ordering, a filter or operator-valued output distribution.

TheCascadeOfObservers defines a successor relation on four labelled levels, with its own explicit ONTO scope; it is not cascaded optical systems. Custo's Lindblad cascade concerns weight-matrix fractalisation/registration, not the device bath. Patent temporal dilation is metric time dilation. R7 merely allows future reduction/dilation after proving a narrow unitality obstruction; it does not construct one.

No ready input-output/QRT/Hudson-Parthasarathy/Langevin or temporal-mode implementation located in these eight texts and checked R58 index candidates. Lexical non-hits are not proof about all IALD. This report does not certify mathematical absence or forbid another implementation elsewhere.

next_step: Reuse H, five collapse operators and full semigroup; construct only the named output dilation/readout contract. State bath input (e.g. independent vacuum only as explicit hypothesis), scattering/port assignment, monitored fractions, LO phase and temporal test functions; justify conditional two-time regression and distributional shot-noise term. A GKLS representation alone does not uniquely identify physical output channels. No need to rebuildL64.
